title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who gets the ball
hook: The last inning is close. Who gets the ball in the circle?
intro: The whole team looks at you.
One player is raising a hand.
statement: Who you hand the ball to sends a message to the team.
q1: Do you pick your most reliable pitcher —
q2: or give the chance to a player who wants it?
q3: How will the player feel if it goes badly?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids grow
t2: when they get chances at the big moment.
cta: Coaches — who pitches the big inning?
ctaLines: Best arm. A rotation. Whoever earned it.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
The last inning is close. Who gets the ball in the circle?
The whole team looks at you. One player is raising a hand.
Who you hand the ball to sends a message to the team.
Your most reliable pitcher or a rotation. Every team is different.
Who pitches the big inning? Share your habit in the comments.
